label: Blind sample 075: Hansen forest loss 2019, tile 00N_060W

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.03 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2019 (90% interval −0.10 to +0.04). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 12 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.21). Counted by gap size instead, 6 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.11). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
